judged_text: saveChanges() calls `embedding.update({})` but no template in this diff invokes the action, and the server-side PUT /customize/embedding (Admin::EmbeddingController#update) persists nothing — it only re-renders the serializer output. A save affordance that does nothing ships in the client controller, and an admin API endpoint returns 200 with serialized data without writing anything; anyone wiring up a save button later or trusting the PUT endpoint gets a silent no-op.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` and a PUT route (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`) but the action only `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` and `@embedding` is an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`, so the endpoint is a no-op in terms of persistence. On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges() { this.get('embedding').update({}); }`, and `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains only host rows plus an “Add Host” button—no invocation of `saveChanges`. This is unused/misleading plumbing rather than a directly user-visible broken behavior in the current diff (hosts are persisted via `embeddable-host` save/destroy).
